props.text: Semi-Truck Body Shop in Indianapolis, IN
Limited hours on Christmas Eve and New Years Eve

Get your semi-truck back on the road faster by entrusting the Truck Country semi-truck body shop in Indianapolis, Indiana, conveniently located and accessible from Interstate 465. Our semi-truck body shop team is solely focused on your repair and maintenance needs. Our Indianapolis semi-truck body shop specializes in working on Freightliner and Western Star brands and just about any brand of truck! We offer complete and comprehensive services–including body repairs, glass replacement, alignments, and day cab conversions–from a single location. Technicians use the latest technology such as the state-of-the-art frame straightening machine, Josam Play Detectors, and the heated Devilbliss paint booth. From semi-truck bodywork to complete detailing of all makes and models, it pays to give the team of experts at Indianapolis a call!
Our location has ample space for your truck and our technicians to perform maintenance, repairs, and inspections.
Our semi-truck body shop has an alignment rack which is designed to hold your vehicle up, so our skilled team can adjust your wheels and suspension system.
Our location has a Bee Line Chassis and Correction system which is used to measure and fix any misalignments in your vehicle’s frame.
Our experienced techs offer complete or partial paint jobs.
We want to give you the best service. One service that we offer to every customer is daily and weekly updates on your vehicle.
Our skilled techs will replace damaged and broken glass on your vehicle.
Fiberglass and SMC Repair can become damaged on your semi-truck. We will repair these components.
Our location offers pick-up and delivery of vehicles!
